title: Ciphertext symbols and differences around LP2 doublets
reader_title: What surrounds the repeated rune pairs?
reader_intro: A doublet is two identical neighboring runes after punctuation is removed. This check examines their symbols and neighbors, including whether pairs crossing a hyphen have different surroundings from pairs within a word under the stored separator rules.

reader_test.input: The 86 repeated rune pairs in LP2-00–55 and the rune values immediately around them; all comparisons use the archived text.
reader_test.action: Keep each page’s repeat positions fixed and shuffle its nonzero steps between rune values 5,000 times. Separately shuffle the hyphen labels among eligible pairs 10,000 times globally and 10,000 times within pages.
reader_test.check: Compare repeated-symbol counts and before/after differences with the first control; compare complete neighboring-rune counts for hyphen-crossing and within-word pairs under the stored separator rules with the label controls. Neither control explains why repeats are scarce.

question: Do doublet symbols or their neighboring ciphertext differences show extra local ordering beyond the observed zero mask and each page difference inventory?
summary: Across 86 doublets, same-symbol collisions and before/after difference imbalance fall inside fixed-mask controls. A companion comparison of the 22 hyphen-crossing and 63 within-token events finds no unusual whole-label context separation under its conditional controls.

scope.representation: Archived LP2-00--55 ciphertext rune indices and within-page differences; zero positions and each page nonzero-difference multiset retained.
scope.procedure: Measure doublet-symbol collision pairs and before/after difference imbalance, then shuffle only nonzero differences separately within each page while keeping the observed zero mask and first ciphertext rune. In a companion audit, join boundary categories to event positions and compare complete before/after ciphertext-rune distributions under global and within-page boundary-label shuffles.
scope.parameters: 29-rune modulus; 5,000 difference permutations with seed 330122; 10,000 global and within-page boundary-label permutations with seed 33012217; no cross-page transitions.
scope.exclusions: Plaintext recovery, key inference, probability of the 86-event zero mask, independent full image transcription, English context scoring and post-selection significance.

finding: There are 123 same-symbol event pairs and a before/after imbalance of 27.786; both sit within their declared conditional ranges. The 29 event-symbol counts span 0 to 7, and 85 nonzero differences are available on each side. The hyphen-versus-within-token whole-label score is 51.321; 6,495/10,000 global and 8,626/10,000 page-stratified conditional shuffles reach at least that score.
limitations: Conditioning fixes the 86 zero positions and pagewise difference inventories, so these controls cannot explain the low doublet count or test triple rarity. Boundary-label exchangeability is also only a descriptive benchmark; only 40 events can move in the page-stratified control. Metrics respond to earlier observations and do not supply prospective p-values. The input is archived text, not a new image review.
next_steps: Check a fully specified key generator against held-out positions or an independent transcription; do not treat ciphertext neighbors as English plaintext cribs.
